Reference / runtime/layout

runtime/layout#

The native layer under text/layout: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under text/layout: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Native bulk primitives for text/layout.

This module is intentionally low-level. Applications should construct the validated value objects from text/layout instead of calling these actions directly.

Public API#

native dedent#

native dedent(origin is string) is string

origin without the indentation its lines share.

native wrap#

native wrap(origin is string, width is int) is string

origin wrapped to width columns.

native shorten#

native shorten(origin is string, width is int, placeholder is string) is string

origin cut to width with placeholder.
